==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{af|ru|из-|верну́ть|-ся}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|изверну́ться}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|изверну́ться|pf|impf=извора́чиваться,извёртываться}}

# to [[turn]] [[sharply]]
# to [[twist]] [[deftly]] {{q|to [[accomplish]] or [[avoid]] something}}
# {{lb|ru|figurative}} to [[find]] a way out of a [[predicament]], to be [[resourceful]]
# {{lb|ru|figurative}} to [[try]] to [[get rid]] of something [[unpleasant]]
# {{lb|ru|figurative|colloquial}} to use [[cunning]] or [[trickery]], to [[contrive]]

====Conjugation====
{{ru-conj|pf|3b|изверну́ться}}
